what: Hand-drawn ornaments beside titles (hatching, loop, speech bubble) stay hidden at .6x and transparent, then play once when they enter the area excluding the bottom 20% of the screen — opacity clears in .5s ease-out and size bounces 1→1.25→.9→1.1→1 in .8s ease-out. The ‹soft› type bounces less with 1.15, .95, 1.05 (hero title, sub-page hero handwriting)

options.margin: Offset pulled from the bottom, default -20% (80% line of the screen)
options.scale: Size when hidden, default .6 (also via the CSS variable --fx-from)
options.dur: Bounce length (seconds), default .8 (also settable via the CSS variable --fx-dur)
options.--fx-delay: Delay before the bounce (CSS variable), default 0s — sub-page hero handwriting .4s
options.side: With ‹right›, it triggers not at the bottom of the screen but when crossing a vertical line inset from the right by the margin — a horizontally flowing stage. brand has margin -10%~-50% (screen width 90~50% line)
options.look: pop: .95 and transparent, over .6s linear 1.05 → .95 → 1.02 → 1, fully visible by 35% — Brand illustration and card entrance
options.look: bound: at its own size and transparent, .8s linear, 8% 1.07 fully visible → 17% 1.232 → 34% 1 → 51% 1.071 → 68% 1 → 84% 1.035 → 1 — a festival site’s bird·flower·speech bubble (margin: 0% when one row enters the screen)

from.where: shared.css .ec-bounce — original .c-decorate-bounceScale (opacity .5s ease-out · scale .6) + titleBounceScale .8s ease-out on .is-decorate, IntersectionObserver rootMargin 0 0 -20% 0

shared.css [data-pop] + shared.js checkAppear — when the left edge of an illustration or card crosses the 50–90% line of screen width (data-at), it pops in with pop .6s linear (delayed by --d seconds)
from.options: look: pop; side: right; margin: -50% (data-at .5) · --d via --fx-delay

from.where: index.html bird · flower · speech bubble · interview icons — original .jsObserver .isBoundIn (IntersectionObserver rootMargin 0 · threshold 0 gives .isCue → BoundIn .8s linear forwards)
